summary: The argument proves the stated absolute depth bound for one fixed point when the integer base has dimension one. McCann's Definition 1.1, Proposition 1.3, and Theorem 2.3 expressly support the absolutely continuous displacement interpolants and the q=infinity density inequality used in (2). The near-maximum interval and concavity tail estimates retain more than W/25000 of the original mixed-integer mass. The likelihood-ratio calculation establishes the required simultaneous centroid approximation in each unchanged actual fiber's own covariance. Accepted fact 711f1969d2e61d1c applies with n=1 and the explicitly identified affine map, original weights, centroids, and covariances. The multi-fiber slab, singleton cylinder, zero-volume branch, and final monotonicity over original closed ambient halfspaces are all valid.
